title: Polynomial evaluation is Gaussian-integrable
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $\mathbb K$ be a complete normed field equal to $\mathbb R$ or $\mathbb C$, and let $P$ be a polynomial in $n$ variables with coefficients in $\mathbb K$. For every exponent $p\in[0,\infty]$ other than $\infty$, the function on $\mathbb R^n$ obtained by evaluating $P$ at the coordinatewise images of $x$ in $\mathbb K$ belongs to $L^p$ for the product standard Gaussian measure.
hypotheses_covered: $\mathbb K$ is a real or complex complete normed field
$P$ is a polynomial in variables indexed by $\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$ with coefficients in $\mathbb K$
$p$ is a nonnegative extended real exponent and $p\ne\infty$
